notes: ServerVersionEntry.latest (ServerJarProviders.swift:26-33) is a sentinel row injected by the version-picker UI, not a real catalog entry: id is the literal string "__latest__" and mcVersion is empty. Every provider call site must check `entry.isLatest` (line 34, `id == "__latest__"`) before trusting mcVersion/loaderVersion -- an empty-string mcVersion is never a real version to look up. Separately, id is NOT interchangeable with mcVersion for every family: true for the four downloadAndGo flavors (Vanilla/Paper/Purpur/Fabric), false for the two installStep flavors (NeoForge/Forge), whose id is the paired "{mc}—{loaderVersion}" string built by listVersionPairs. Recorded per docs/msc2/families/phase7-scope.md's "What install/downloadVersion need per family, precisely" section -- a version-change route that keys off id alone will silently misbehave for the paired families.
